sources.description: Adam Prentice started his college career at Colorado State, where he played for four seasons, before playing one final season at South Carolina. He would then declare for the 2021 NFL Draft, where he ultimately went undrafted before signing as an undrafted free agent with the Denver Broncos. Prentice was among the players waived by […]
